objects.description: [Shamoon](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0140) creates a new service named “ntssrv” to execute the payload. [Shamoon](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0140) can also spread via [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029).(Citation: Palo Alto Shamoon Nov 2016)(Citation: McAfee Shamoon December19 2018)
